the sim build's fixed hashers and the FastMap and FastSet aliases go, as no build is seeded through the hasher; `HashMap` and `HashSet` are types of the module's own around the standard ones, with lookups, inserts, and removals by key and walks only in key order, so no hash order reaches a stored byte, a WAL record, or a result through any user, and the module alone carries the disallowed_types exemption; the map has a view, the wrapped map's, and its `len` and `get` carry vstd's clauses of the wrapped map, proved, so a proof over a map stands over it; its tests check the order of every walk

its reads and writes go through host's doors, generic over `IoDoors`; `replace` drains and inserts in place of a splice, whose drop can allocate; its read count for tests is per backend; `written_run` comes here from packs.rs, since the pack writer calls it; a lookup is proved in Verus, since the forwards are runs of an index (design item 6) and `follow`'s proof rests on it: the searches within sorted values, the blocks a run's fences leave for a key, and the newest run's answer across an index's runs, over a source of decoded blocks whose one trusted statement is that a block read is the block the run holds, asked with the capability its read needs as a parameter (`Source<C, ..>`, `Runs`), which no source holds (design item 17); a run keeps its fences in a type that only sorted keys make, and refuses at its read fences out of order and at a block's decode entries out of order or outside the block's fences; `get` is the proved lookup, and returns where a value was read for an error to name; a pack's number is 48 bits, where Doltgrust's is 32, since no number is given twice; its read paths take host's read-only capability

host, io, lock, sim, stop, and thread move to the host and sim crates, or go; of `packs` it exports the list files' records (`Table`, `Runs`, `Tail`), the forwards' file side (`FORWARDING`, `forward_entries`, `kept_forwards`, `followed`), a listed pack (`Listed`), a pack's deletion vector (`Dead`), and the pack state: the record's and the single record's shapes and the processes' slots, which the server's table of kinds lists, `Packs`, the writers' and the roots' values, the marking's, the retirement's proof, the reservation and the removal of what is due, and the settle's report; SIM and simulated go with the sim feature; it exports `Kept` and `MANIFEST`; it exports `even_manifests`, `marked`, and `raised`; it exports `repositories`; it exports `check` and `Checked`; it exports `DELTA`; it exports the collection's `Retired`

a walk that meets a record it can't read splits the failure with `own`, so a host's error returns and only chunks' own marks the record lost (PLAN item 17); a writer's unfinished file is listed in its backend's own memory when the writer is made, a writer dropped before it finishes only sets its entry's flag, since a drop has no capability for file I/O and may not allocate, and the backend's next writer removes the flagged files through `host::remove_leftover` as it starts, and an abandon unlists its file only once it is removed; the pack state in design item 6's form, a module for each part: the list files' records are `Table`'s and `Runs`', each applied one record at a time by a reader from where it last read; a file's WHOLE record begins with the generation of its whole write, which a tail carries; a table's WHOLE record keeps each tablespace's runs tail, its ADDED record carries its tablespace's runs tail after the add, and MOVED says where a runs file ends after a change to it alone, so one tail leads to every runs file; a record is checked whole before it changes anything; a runs line always names its packs, and marks a run the startup process's settle wrote from a pack whose address table didn't read whole (`lossy`); the forwarding file is a list of runs in a runs file's form, each run an address index's run of copies' new places under their old places' keys, a retirement's forwards one run (`forward_entries`), dropped places left out by a merge of every run (`kept_forwards`), and a walk (`followed`) is `follow` over those runs, a forward that leads to no later pack being damage of the block it was read from; a pack is listed with the generation of its deletion vector (`Listed`), which a whole record keeps for each pack and a record of a kind of its own (VECTOR) names for a listed pack, so every process reads the same vector.
